autoFixPromptDescription: This prompt is used only for this task. Leave it blank to use the default prompt. Add <0>{{placeholder}}</0> when you want Kandev to include PR feedback, queue-removal context, and available failed merge-group checks.
autoFixRoundExplanation: Auto-fix has used {{current}} of {{max}} rounds for this PR. A round is counted when Kandev sends or queues a CI auto-fix message. Kandev waits for all PR checks to finish before starting a new CI auto-fix turn, so the agent gets the final failed checks and current comments together. Updating an already queued auto-fix message does not use another round. When this is at {{max}}/{{max}} and there is no pending auto-fix message left to update, Kandev pauses auto-fix for this PR so it cannot loop forever. Disable and re-enable auto-fix after manual review to start over.

watchesThisTaskSLinkedPull: Watches this task's linked pull request during the 1 minute PR refresh loop. Auto-fix queues task prompts for newly observed feedback, auto-merge waits for the PR to be ready, and the notification switches wake the task's agent when the workspace's connected GitHub account is requested for review or the PR reaches a terminal state. Review requests silently baseline the account's current request state before notifying on a later request.
whichAllowedGithubRepositoriesToMonitor: Which allowed GitHub repositories to monitor for this watch.
withManagedWorkspaceCredentialsKandevCon: With Managed workspace credentials, Kandev configures agentctl as Git's credential helper inside newly launched task processes. When Git requests credentials for an attached GitHub HTTPS repository, the helper redeems a task- and repository-scoped broker lease. The credential is returned to Git on demand and is not written to the repository or Git config. The gh command uses Kandev's broker-aware shim. Executor inheritance skips both and uses credentials visible in the selected executor. Changes apply to new task launches and the next resume, not already-running processes.
